## ST_BUFFER and ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE
# Source: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions.md
# The examples' vertex counts, the polygon return type, the discarding of shells contracted to a
# point, and endcap and side affecting only linestrings. BigQuery answered the rest.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2)'), 50, 2))
=> "9"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(100 2)'), 50))
=> "33"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(100 2)'), 50, num_seg_quarter_circle => 8))
=> "33"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(1 2)'), 100, 25))
=> "6"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(100 2)'), 100, 1))
=> "24"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(100 2)'), 100, tolerance_meters => 1))
=> "24"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100))
=> "ST_Polygon"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100))
=> "ST_Polygon"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, 1))
=> "ST_Polygon"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 0.01 0, 0.01 0.01, 0 0.01, 0 0))'), -10000))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, endcap => 'FLAT'), ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, side => 'LEFT'), ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 1, endcap => 'FLAT', side => 'RIGHT'), ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 1))
=> "true"

# NULL arguments.

SELECT ST_BUFFER(NULL, 10)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 10, NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 10, use_spheroid => NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 10, endcap => NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 10, side => NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 10, NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(NULL, 10, 1)
=> null

# The vertices and their order.

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), 1000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((-0.00899307563648861 4.76633006776727e-05, -4.76633012647816e-05 -0.0089930756364855, 0.00899307563648861 -4.76633006776527e-05, 4.76633012647616e-05 0.0089930756364855, -0.00899307563648861 4.76633006776727e-05))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 2))
=> "POLYGON((0.999100143307361 2.00000458174623, 0.999360463545893 1.99936733267952, 0.999995415216894 1.99910069147825, 1.0006330525881 1.99936085276583, 1.00089985668761 1.99999541776085, 1.00063953694732 2.0006326670715, 1.00000458478813 2.00089930852174, 0.999366946918686 2.00063914699022, 0.999100143307361 2.00000458174623))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 25))
=> "POLYGON((0.999100143307361 2.00000458174623, 0.999717568746973 1.99914612265957, 1.00072530425015 1.9994676926436, 1.00073069445796 2.00052489321386, 0.999726289237549 2.00085670912057, 0.999100143307361 2.00000458174623))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 90), 1000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((179.312483645361 89.9910067980567, -90.6875163546167 89.9910067980567, -0.687516354638704 89.9910067980566, 89.3124836453387 89.9910067980567, 179.312483645361 89.9910067980567))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0), 1000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((179.991006924364 -4.76633006776727e-05, -179.999952336699 -0.0089930756364855, -179.991006924364 4.76633006776927e-05, 179.999952336699 0.0089930756364855, 179.991006924364 -4.76633006776727e-05))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.1 0)'), 1000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0 0.00899320194334687, -0.00899320194334687 -7.38544482359676e-11, 0 -0.00899320194334687, 0.1 -0.00899320194334687, 0.108993201943347 7.38544482359676e-11, 0.1 0.00899320194334687, 0 0.00899320194334687))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.1 0)'), 1000, 1, endcap => 'FLAT'))
=> "POLYGON((0 0.00899320194334687, 0 -0.00899320194334687, 0.1 -0.00899320194334687, 0.1 0.00899320194334687, 0 0.00899320194334687))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.1 0)'), 1000, 1, side => 'LEFT'))
=> "POLYGON((0.108993201943347 0, 0.1 0.00899320194334687, 0 0.00899320194334687, -0.00899320194334687 0, 0 0, 0.1 0, 0.108993201943347 0))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.1 0)'), 1000, 1, endcap => 'FLAT', side => 'RIGHT'))
=> "POLYGON((0 -0.00899320194334687, 0.1 -0.00899320194334687, 0.1 0, 0 0, 0 -0.00899320194334687))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.1 0, 0.1 0.1)'), 1000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0 0.00899320194334687, -0.00899320194334687 -7.38544482359676e-11, 0 -0.00899320194334687, 0.1 -0.00899320194334687, 0.108993201943347 3.47176211691235e-19, 0.108993215640794 0.0999999987681612, 0.0999999999261454 0.108993201943347, 0.0910067843592061 0.0999999987681612, 0.0910067968248151 0.00899320306440319, 0 0.00899320194334687))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))'), 10000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0 -0.0899320194334687, 1 -0.0899320194334687, 1.08993201943347 4.01775032842611e-18, 1.08994571857957 0.99999876803763, 1.00001369955503 1.08993201839037, -1.36995550319894e-05 1.08993201839037, -0.0899457185795683 0.99999876803763, -0.0899320194334687 0, 0 -0.0899320194334687))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0))'), -10000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0.0899332513181302 0.0899331405321459, 0.91006674868187 0.0899331405321458, 0.910055513459002 0.910079324068009, 0.0899444865409983 0.91007932406801, 0.0899332513181302 0.0899331405321459))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0), (0.4 0.4, 0.6 0.4, 0.6 0.6, 0.4 0.6, 0.4 0.4))'), -10000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0.0899332513181302 0.0899331405321459, 0.91006674868187 0.0899331405321458, 0.910055513459002 0.910079324068009, 0.0899444865409983 0.91007932406801, 0.0899332513181302 0.0899331405321459), (0.399998356218292 0.689932019418448, 0.600001643781708 0.689932019418448, 0.689936950725441 0.599999260870616, 0.689934211063154 0.399999507257085, 0.599999926144491 0.310067980566562, 0.599998904197804 0.310067980573207, 0.400001095802196 0.310067980573207, 0.310065788953852 0.399998485325362, 0.310065788936846 0.399999507257085, 0.310063049274559 0.599999260870616, 0.399998356218292 0.689932019418448))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0), (0.4 0.4, 0.6 0.4, 0.6 0.6, 0.4 0.6, 0.4 0.4))'), 15000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0 -0.134898029150203, 1 -0.134898029150203, 1.1348980291502 6.02662239937936e-18, 1.13491857782715 0.99999722808538, 1.00002054963516 1.13489802758554, -2.05496351571447e-05 1.13489802758554, -0.134918577827155 0.99999722808538, -0.134898029150203 0, 0 -0.134898029150203))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 0.01 0)'), 1000, 1))
=> "POLYGON((0.00499466589370651 0.00399335545254848, 4.76633012647616e-05 0.0089930756364855, -0.00899307563648861 4.76633006776727e-05, -4.76633012647816e-05 -0.0089930756364855, 0.00500533420610059 -0.00399335756146776, 0.00995235553398603 -0.0089930757362926, 0.0189930757362957 -4.76444654270722e-05, 0.010047644466014 0.0089930757362926, 0.00499466589370651 0.00399335545254848))"

# Fractional segment counts and their limits. BigQuery's error says at least 0.5, but it rejects
# 0.5 too.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 2.5))
=> "11"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 0.5))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Number of quarter circle segments out of range. Number of quarter circle segments must be at least 0.5 and less than 392.5.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 0.4))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Number of quarter circle segments out of range. Number of quarter circle segments must be at least 0.5 and less than 392.5.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 0))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Number of quarter circle segments out of range. Number of quarter circle segments must be at least 0.5 and less than 392.5.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, -1))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Number of quarter circle segments out of range. Number of quarter circle segments must be at least 0.5 and less than 392.5.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Argument num_seg_quarter_circle cannot be NaN

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 392))
=> "1569"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 393))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Number of quarter circle segments out of range. Number of quarter circle segments must be at least 0.5 and less than 392.5.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Argument num_seg_quarter_circle cannot be +-inf

# Tolerances and their limits: a tolerance of the radius or more leaves a point nothing, and the
# tolerance must exceed 1e-6 times the radius, so a negative radius fails.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 100))
=> "0"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 200))
=> "0"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 0.0001))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Error tolerance is too small. Tolerance must be at least 0.0001 percent of the buffer radius.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 0.00001))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Error tolerance is too small. Tolerance must be at least 0.0001 percent of the buffer radius.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 0))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Error tolerance is too small. Tolerance must be at least 0.0001 percent of the buffer radius.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, -1))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Error tolerance is too small. Tolerance must be at least 0.0001 percent of the buffer radius.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Argument tolerance_meters cannot be NaN

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Argument tolerance_meters cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), -100, 1))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Error tolerance is too small. Tolerance must be at least 0.0001 percent of the buffer radius.

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 0, 1))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

# Zero, negative, tiny and huge radii.

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 0))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 0))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0))'), 0))
=> "POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 1e-9))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), -100))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), -100))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0))'), -1e9))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 2e7))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 1e9))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'), -1000))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POLYGON((0 0, 120 0, -120 0, 0 0)), POLYGON((0 0, -120 0, 120 0, 0 0)))"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY'), 1000))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Argument buffer_radius_meters cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Argument buffer_radius_meters cannot be +-inf

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Argument buffer_radius_meters cannot be NaN

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64), 1))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Argument buffer_radius_meters cannot be NaN

# endcap and side in any case.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, endcap => 'flat'))
=> "5"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, endcap => 'SQUARE'))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Supported end cap style are 'ROUND' or 'FLAT'. Argument was 'SQUARE'.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, endcap => ''))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Supported end cap style are 'ROUND' or 'FLAT'. Argument was ''.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, endcap => 'SQUARE'))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Supported end cap style are 'ROUND' or 'FLAT'. Argument was 'SQUARE'.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, side => 'left'))
=> "21"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, side => 'TOP'))
=> error: ST_BUFFER: Supported line sides are 'LEFT', 'RIGHT' or 'BOTH'. Argument was 'TOP'.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 100, 1, endcap => 'SQUARE'))
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE: Supported end cap style are 'ROUND' or 'FLAT'. Argument was 'SQUARE'.

SELECT SAFE.ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, endcap => 'SQUARE')
=> null

# use_spheroid; the documentation takes only FALSE.

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, use_spheroid => FALSE))
=> "33"

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, use_spheroid => TRUE)
=> error: ST_BUFFER does not yet implement use_spheroid=true.

SELECT ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), 100, 1, use_spheroid => TRUE)
=> error: ST_BUFFERWITHTOLERANCE does not yet implement use_spheroid=true.

SELECT ST_BUFFER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY'), 100, use_spheroid => TRUE)
=> error: ST_BUFFER does not yet implement use_spheroid=true.
